item.title: Role Model Reflects on ‘Sally’ Success, Therapy & How Girlfriend Dakota Johnson Ended Up on His Album
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music news and trends. I'm your host, [Name], and today we're talking about Role Model, the singer-songwriter behind the hit song "Sally, When the Wine Runs Out". His new album, "Chuck Timely & the Hourglass", is set to drop on August 7th, and he's opening up about the creative process and personal journey that went into making it.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: In a new interview with NYLON, Role Model, whose real name is Tucker Pillsbury, reveals that writing the album pushed him to start therapy for the first time. He says that the process of making the album made him look at himself on a deeper level, and that's had a profound impact on his life.
[Clip of Role Model's quote plays] Role Model: "Making the album and writing all those songs — I think me going to therapy now is a result of that. The album did something very good for me in the way that it made me look at myself a little bit deeper."
Host: The album follows the success of "Sally, When the Wine Runs Out", which entered Billboard's Alternative Adult Airplay chart back in 2025. But despite the pressure to top that success, Role Model says he didn't feel the need to outdo himself. In fact, he jokes that the song contains some of his worst lyrics, and that the bar was low going into his next album.
[Soft music continues to play]
Host: The album also features a surprise cameo from his girlfriend, Dakota Johnson, who appears on the track "Love I You". Role Model says she spontaneously recorded a spoken-word bridge during a studio visit, and it ended up being an amazing addition to the song.
[Outro music starts to play]
Host: "Chuck Timely & the Hourglass" arrives on August 7th, and includes the previously released singles "Joy" and "High Hopes 3000". We can't wait to hear the full album and see what's next for Role Model. Thanks for tuning in to our podcast, and we'll catch you on the next one!
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
